name: Osananajimi no Kokoro ga Yometara Dou Suru ka?
original_name: 幼馴染の心が読めたらどうするか?
source:
I can see every feeling that beats in her heart.

Kisa and I met up after many years apart. It was a bit awkward as I searched for small talk in front of her beauty. Then I realized I could see read her own inner thoughts!

She actually liked me. She wanted to have sex with me.

I know exactly what to do. What a relief! There's no way this love can fail... can it? That's the premise of this "dere"-pathic ADV!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ140827.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我能看见她心中跳动的每一份感情。多年分别后，我与木沙重逢，在她的美貌面前努力寻找闲聊话题。随后我意识到自己能读懂她的内心！她其实喜欢我，也想和我做爱。我知道该怎么办了。太好了！这段恋情不可能失败……对吧？这就是“读心傲娇”ADV的设定。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ140827.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
